chunks: If they are driven out, they will not go with them; and if they are attacked, they will not aid them. And even if they aided them, they will turn their backs, then they will not be helped.
ai.seo_question: What are the three main traits of hypocrisy described in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Banu Umayya or the broader hypocritical faction within the early Muslim community, illustrating their strategic withdrawal during critical battles like Uhud or Khandaq. The phrase 'they will not be helped' underscores the divine consequence of their insincere allegiance, contrasting their political opportunism with the steadfastness of the Ahl al-Bayt and true believers.
